signal.note: The failure mode is the reverse of the event branch. Nothing about the occurrence is closed; the underlying quantity simply stops being sampled directly because a reliable intermediary reports it. The intermediary being correct for a long time is what builds the reliance, so the hazard accumulates with reliability rather than against it.

procedure_gap.ground: Not applicable on this branch. Procedure is not the missing quantity; direct sampling is.

open: Nothing is quantified. Included because the branch needs a case that is purely instrument-side, with no event closure mixed in, to keep the two apart.
The prediction that distinguishes this branch: failures cluster on instruments with long correct records, not on unfamiliar situations. This inverts how instrument reliability is normally scored.
The rail-crossing signal is the same branch with better data available. It is a separate case file and is not yet written.
